🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical style. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; Tech weak while Energy/Materials/Industrials are positive, and Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5). Two confirmations: mixed sector leadership (cyclicals up, Tech down) and net breadth positive but not strong → neutral.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +5.59% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +5.71% | 1M: +27.25%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities and Materials also showing strength: Utilities (1W: +2.56%, 6 stocks) and Materials DOW (1W: +7.01% | 1M: +23.31%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -5.64% | 1M: -8.24%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -9.02%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -14.04% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND. Communication and Consumer Discretionary also weak this week (Communication 1W: -1.39%, Consumer Disc. 1W: -0.91%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +14.72% | 1M: +49.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.05% | 1M: +24.24%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +7.01% | 1M: +23.31%) ABOVE TREND, PNC (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +6.68% | 1M: +28.30%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NFLX (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -9.19%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -5.64% | 1M: -8.24%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -6.79% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -7.28% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in large-cap Tech and select Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +14.72% | 1M: +49.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.05% | 1M: +24.24%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +7.01% | 1M: +23.31%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: NVDA (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +5.27%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -2.26% | 1M: +8.57%) CORRECTION, AMZN (1W: -4.65% | 1M: +2.01%) CORRECTION — tactical caution, not a full regime shift.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is mixed-to-weak with notable large-cap pressure; NVDA (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +5.27%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -5.64% | 1M: -8.24%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -9.02%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: 19 stocks, sector negative this week and showing concentrated leadership swings.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are mixed with idiosyncratic winners and losers: PNC (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND but WFC (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND and JPM (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -3.07%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth: 20 stocks, internally rotating.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows steady defensive interest: JNJ (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +4.66%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +6.04% | 1M: +6.29%) ABOVE TREND while ISRG (1W: -6.79% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: 15 stocks, generally positive.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical/energy exposure and select Materials/Industrial names given broad leadership there; reduce exposure to pressured mega-cap Tech where multiple large names are BELOW TREND or in CORRECTION. Monitor NVDA/GOOGL/AMZN CORRECTIONs for weekly confirmation before reloading.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +14.72% | 1M: +49.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.05% | 1M: +24.24%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.59% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -14.04% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -5.64% | 1M: -8.24%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -9.19%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.70%, 8 stocks), Materials (1W: +1.79%, 7 stocks), Industrials (1W: +1.09%, 13 stocks) as continuation candidates. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.37%, 19 stocks) and Communication (1W: -1.39%, 7 stocks) for downside risk and dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch weekly closes and follow-through: NVDA (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +5.27%) CORRECTION — need a weekly reclaim of the 1M range to re-establish trend; AAPL (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -9.02%) BELOW TREND — continued weekly weakness would signal further downside; INTC (1W: +14.72% | 1M: +49.53%) ABOVE TREND — sustainment above this week’s breakout high would confirm momentum.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+65): JNJ (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +4.66%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. AMD (+50): AMD (1W: +13.05% | 1M: +24.24%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed and priced in. CVX (+50): CVX (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-80): ORCL (1W: -14.04% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed, distribution. MA (-50): MA (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -6.68%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. TSLA (-45): TSLA (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -10.74%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical style; Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. INTC (1W: +14.72% | 1M: +49.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.05% | 1M: +24.24%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +5.59% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major-tech divergence—NVDA (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +5.27%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -2.26% | 1M: +8.57%) CORRECTION and AMZN (1W: -4.65% | 1M: +2.01%) CORRECTION—watch weekly confirmation and ORCL (-80 sentiment) distribution.
